text_block_list.text:
To unravel the mystery of the treasure map 
left behind by Matikanefukukitaru and her 
older sister in their childhood, we paid a 
visit to her family shrine.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nineteen, twenty! All right, this is 
exactly twenty steps from the bell rope!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Look, there's little ants!
choice_data_list:
Hmm, doesn't look like there's anything 
special here...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let me see... what was it again...? I feel 
like there was something we were supposed 
to do... Ah!

She nonchalantly grabs a shovel and begins 
digging up the ground—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Found it! The "Coded Letter" buried 
beneath the dirt!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Brava! A secret cipher, how utterly 
delightful!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
—It's the syllable "Ba"! All right, let's 
keep this momentum rolling and find the 
rest!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The "Kagura Stage"... Ehehe, what a 
throwback. Big Sis looked so gorgeous in 
her dancing costume... I remember copying 
her makeup while looking in the mirror—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see, then that means—... Ha-ha-ha! 
Behold, I have found it! Behind the 
mirror... is "Ko"!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Floral Furnishing"... Um... Could it be 
referring to that vase over there... 
perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No, I bet it's this hanging scroll. 
Actually, that's a picture my big sister 
painted. Behind this hanging scroll, there 
should be—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
—"Ki", found it! ...She was so serious and 
good at everything. I wonder what kind of 
smile she had on her face when hiding this 
note.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Look at all the koi fishies! The 
garden is huge~!
choice_data_list:
Doesn't look like there's anywhere to hide 
a code here, though...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure there must be some hint buried in 
the memories of me and Big Sis—

text_block_list.name: 幼いフクキタル
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis! There's writing on the Master of 
the Pond's back~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Everyone, please search for the 
"Master" of this pond! The code should be 
on its back!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, "Ba" at the bell, and "Ko" at 
the Kagura stage!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ki" from the hanging scroll of painted 
flowers, and "Ri" floating upon the 
shimmering koi's back... isn't that right!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Leave the rest to me! Rearranging all the 
letters we've gathered so far gives us...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of paulownia boxes, it's right 
over here! On three! Hrrrngh, YAAY!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Woooow~! Such a pretty kimono! Is this the 
treasure!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This kimono...! I remember now... That's 
right... this is—!

text_block_list.name: 幼いフクキタル
text_block_list.text:
So lucky, Big Sis! Mom gave you a kimono, 
didn't she! Fuku wants to wear Big Sis's 
clothes too~!

text_block_list.name: フクキタルの姉
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, me too. I can't wait for the day I 
get to give it to you, Fuku!

text_block_list.name: フクキタルの姉
text_block_list.text:
...I know. I'll make a special treasure 
map for you! Once you grow up, Fuku, the 
treasure hunt begins!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...So this is where she hid it. Her most 
special treasure.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Fuku-chan! Something dropped on the 
floor! Is that a letter?

"—To Fuku when you grow up. 
Congratulations! I love bright, cheerful 
Fuku so much! Please always stay best 
friends with me!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, Big Sis...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...I really wanted you to see it too. Me 
wearing this kimono, Big Sis...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I've made up my mind!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be so massively happy that I'll 
look totally stunning in this festive 
kimono!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And then—for Big Sis's sake too... I swear 
I'll greet the most ultra-blessed festive 
day ever!!
...Thank you.

I faintly sensed a presence behind us. It 
was a warm, gentle presence, like a sunny 
spring day.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! When we all grow up, let's put 
on kimonos and take a photo together!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a splendid idea! I, too, shall 
dress up so magnificently that even the 
fairies will blush in awe!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A photo sounds wonderful...! U-Um, well, 
that is... if Fukukitaru-san is okay with 
it, of course...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...! I'd love to~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...And for that to happen, I'll give it my 
all...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what your sister wishes to see is 
not those tears. It is a smile fitting for 
the sunniest of days!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha! Ehehe, that's so fun! 
Let's all do it!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ha... Ha-ha-haaa...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, you're right... I'm gonna make it 
echo all the way to the heavens!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...Fu, NWA-HA-HA-HA!

Wiping away her tears, Matikanefukukitaru 
laughs with her whole mouth open. Seeing 
her determined to live life with the 
bright, cheerful energy her sister loved 
so dearly, she looked truly radiant.
